actions.reason: Waiting and observing a server is not equivalent to a Moodle repair action. A read-only probe needs a separate reviewed observation contract.
Restarting an Alibaba server management service does not identify which Moodle service or node should be restarted.
Runtime environment reinstallation has no reviewed Moodle staging equivalent or rollback.
Server reboot with service migration is not represented by the Moodle catalog.
Server re-imaging with migration has no approved Moodle target, scope, rollback, or verifier contract.
Hardware repair ticket requires an operator; no automated Moodle executor action is appropriate.
